abilities.name: Violet Edge
abilities.text: Once per round, before a Signal or Guile battle/test, add +1.

abilities.name: Glassmere Footwork
abilities.text: Descriptive only. Rumi specializes in slipping past lesser enemies in anomaly and mirror ground.

abilities.name: Rift-Flame Hand
abilities.text: Descriptive only. A failed Signal read leaves Rumi with a revised route insight for a later decision.

abilities.name: Courtbreaker Smile
abilities.text: Descriptive only. Rumi turns successful Guile reads in courtly or mirrored ground into route intelligence. Weakness: Violet Edge cannot be used on Forge or Command tests.
